title: moreabout-records-prebuild-inadequacy
intention: When /moreabout fires during a build, record that it had to be called as a signal that the prebuild packet was insufficient — so the prebuild learns to include that context next time.
why: The prebuild should improve over time. If the builder has to reach for /moreabout, that's a measurement: the prebuild missed something. Without recording that signal, the prebuild never learns and the same gap recurs.
traces_to: Law 1 (re-deriving the settled is a defect — the prebuild should carry what was needed last time). Law 3 (nothing known until measured — the inadequacy is a measurement). The cocoon derivation (cheaper stages pre-process; the prebuild is that cheaper stage).

falsifier.proves_red: Done when a /moreabout firing during /sail leaves a record that the prebuild can read on its next run. Wrong intent if the prebuild has no mechanism to consume that signal (would need a prebuild learning loop first).
